verses.1: Do not choose to do evil, and evil will not take hold of you.
verses.2: Withdraw from the iniquitous, and evil will withdraw from you.
verses.3: Son, do not sow evil in the furrows of injustice, and you will not reap them sevenfold.
verses.4: Do not seek a role of leadership from the Lord, and do not seek a seat of honor from the king.
verses.5: You should not justify yourself before God, for he is the Knower of hearts. And by no means should you wish to seem wise before the king.
verses.6: Do not seek to become a judge, unless you have sufficient strength to shatter iniquities. Otherwise, you might fear the face of the powerful, and so establish a scandal within your integrity.
verses.7: You should not sin against the multitude of a city, nor should you cast yourself against the people.
verses.8: And you should not bind two sins together. For even in one sin, you will not go unpunished.
verses.9: Do not be cowardly in your soul.
verses.10: You should not be unwilling to beg, nor to give alms.
verses.11: You should not say: “God will look with favor on the multitude of my gifts, and when I make an offering to the most high God, he will accept my gift.”
verses.12: You should not ridicule a man in bitterness of soul. For there is One who humbles and who exalts: the all-seeing God.
verses.13: Do not love a lie against your brother, nor should you act the same toward your friend.
verses.14: Do not be willing to devise a lie of any kind. For the practice of lying is not good.
verses.15: Do not choose to be verbose among a multitude of elders, and you should not repeat the words of your prayers.
verses.16: You should not hate laborious works, nor the rustic life created by the Most High.
verses.17: You should not consider yourself to be among the multitude of the undisciplined.
verses.18: Remember wrath. For it will not be delayed.
verses.19: Humble your spirit greatly. For the retribution against the flesh of the impious is with fire and worms.
verses.20: Do not betray your friend for the sake of money, and you should not spurn your dearest brother for the sake of gold.
verses.21: Do not choose to depart from a good and understanding wife, whom you have been allotted in the fear of the Lord. For the grace of her modesty is above gold.
verses.22: You should not harm the servant whose works are honest, nor the hired hand who entrusts his life to you.
verses.23: Let an understanding servant be loved by you like your own soul. You should not cheat him out of freedom, nor abandon him to destitution.
verses.24: Are cattle yours? Tend to them. And if they are useful, let them remain with you.
verses.25: Are sons yours? Instruct them, and bow them down from their childhood.
verses.26: Are daughters yours? Watch over their bodies. And you should not display a light-hearted attitude toward them.
verses.27: Give your daughter in marriage, and give her to an understanding man, and you will be doing a great work.
verses.28: If a wife in accord with your soul is yours, you should not reject her. But do not entrust yourself to her who is hateful.
verses.29: With your whole heart, honor your father. And you should not forget the complaints of your mother.
verses.30: Remember that you would not have been born except through them. And so, give back to them as they also have done for you.
verses.31: With all your soul, fear the Lord, and consider his priests to be holy.
verses.32: With all your strength, love him who made you, and you should not abandon his ministers.
verses.33: Honor God from your whole soul, and confer honor on the priests, and continue to purify yourself with your strength.
verses.34: Give them their portion, just as it has been commanded of you, from the first-fruits and from the purifications. And for your ignorant offenses, purify yourself with a smaller offering.
verses.35: You should offer to the Lord the gift of your strength, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the first-fruits of what is holy.
verses.36: And reach out your hand to the poor, so that your atonement and your blessing may be perfected.
verses.37: A gift has grace in the sight of all the living, but you should not prohibit grace for the dead.
verses.38: You should not fail to console those who are weeping, nor to walk with those who are mourning.
verses.39: Do not let yourself be slow to visit the sick. For in this way, you will be confirmed in love.
verses.40: In all your works, remember your very end, and so you will not sin, unto eternity. [ Sirach 8 ]
